paragraphs.text: The Buried Lord , also called the Lord of the Interred , is a demon from Innistrad who was briefly returned to life before being banished by Liesa .

The Buried Lord is a formidable and ancient demon , characterized by his vast size, emaciated face, and a demeanor that combines intelligence with malevolence. He has massive horns and tattered wings, which shimmer with a cloud of dust that sheds from his crackling form, giving him an appearance reminiscent of an embalmed saint shedding his shroud. His eyes are described as cold stars, suggesting an intense, almost supernatural gaze. The Buried Lord exudes a stench of death and possesses a voice that is smooth yet ominous, akin to the sensation of sinking into quicksand or standing before an empty grave.

The Buried Lord was summoned by a group of desperate villagers named Algli , Olutio , and Sruta , who sought his aid to protect them from the various supernatural threats plaguing Innistrad . The summoning ritual appeared to fail initially, leading to despair among the summoners, but Algli's continued presence in the clearing eventually attracts the attention of an angel named Liesa , who had been brought back to life as part of the effects of the ritual.

Liesa explained to Algli that the Buried Lord was not a protector but a predator. As they conversed, the Buried Lord began his new reign of terror, first killing Olutio and then pursuing Sruta. Liesa engaged in a fierce battle with the demon , ultimately managing to wound him severely. Despite her injuries and the Buried Lord's immense power, Liesa drove him away temporarily by striking a fatal blow to his spine.

However, the Buried Lord proved to be resilient and reemerged very shortly thereafter, this time attacking Algli, the weaker target. In a final act of defiance and courage, Algli offered herself as a sacrifice but used the opportunity to thrust a torch into the demon's mouth. This act of bravery allowed Liesa to channel her power and deliver the true killing blow, decapitating the Buried Lord and ensuring his demise and banishment from Innistrad once more. Despite this victory, Liesa felt a lingering connection to the demon, indicating that his influence was not entirely vanquished. At least for the moment, he was defeated.
